# Risk Acceptance Workflow — §6.1.3 Records

**Organisation:** Acme Financial Services Ltd
**ISO 27001:2022 Reference:** Clause 6.1.3 (Information security risk treatment — risk owner approval of residual risk)

This sample shows the three risk-governance tools working together: the methodology is set once (admin, HITL-gated), acceptances are recorded as first-class immutable objects (analyst+, HITL-gated), and the acceptance ledger is queryable by any role.

---

## 1. Methodology — `set_risk_methodology`

Recorded once by the CISO. Every subsequent acceptance freezes the threshold in force at decision time, so later methodology changes never rewrite history.

```json
{
  "likelihood_scale": [
    { "value": 1, "label": "Rare" }, { "value": 2, "label": "Unlikely" },
    { "value": 3, "label": "Possible" }, { "value": 4, "label": "Likely" },
    { "value": 5, "label": "Almost certain" }
  ],
  "impact_scale": [
    { "value": 1, "label": "Negligible" }, { "value": 2, "label": "Minor" },
    { "value": 3, "label": "Moderate" }, { "value": 4, "label": "Major" },
    { "value": 5, "label": "Severe" }
  ],
  "calculation_method": "multiplication",
  "risk_level_bands": [
    { "min": 1, "max": 5, "level": "Low" }, { "min": 6, "max": 11, "level": "Medium" },
    { "min": 12, "max": 19, "level": "High" }, { "min": 20, "max": 25, "level": "Critical" }
  ],
  "acceptance_threshold": 6,
  "review_frequency": "annual",
  "confirmed": false
}
```

The first call returns a preview diff against the current methodology plus a single-use `proposal_id`; the CISO reviews and the call is repeated with `confirmed: true` to commit.

---

## 2. Recording an Acceptance — `record_risk_acceptance`

RISK-007 (payment gateway DDoS) has an `accept` treatment. Before the treatment lifecycle can complete, the risk owner records the decision:

```json
{
  "risk_id": "<uuid of RISK-007>",
  "risk_owner": "Sarah Chen, CISO",
  "decision": "accepted",
  "rationale": "Residual score 6 sits at the acceptance threshold. Upstream DDoS mitigation quotes exceed the annualised loss expectancy; CDN-level rate limiting is in place and the SLA credits cap financial exposure.",
  "review_due_at": "2025-10-01",
  "confirmed": false
}
```

Server-enforced rules:

- A referenced `treatment_plan_id` must belong to the risk and carry residual likelihood + impact.
- Accepting a residual score **above** the threshold requires a substantive rationale (≥ 50 chars).
- The record freezes inherent score, residual score, and the threshold at decision time.
- HITL: nothing is written until the preview is confirmed with the issued `proposal_id`.
- A treatment plan cannot transition to `verified` unless the latest acceptance for its risk is `accepted`.

---

## 3. The Ledger — `list_risk_acceptances`

Query: `{ "decision": "accepted" }`

| ID | Risk | Owner | Decision | Residual (frozen) | Threshold | Decided | Review due |
|----|------|-------|----------|-------------------|-----------|---------|------------|
| RA-001 | RISK-005 | Sarah Chen, CISO | accepted | 3 | 6 | 2024-10-18 | 2024-11-30 |
| RA-002 | RISK-005 | Sarah Chen, CISO | accepted | 6 | 6 | 2024-10-18 | 2025-01-31 |
| RA-003 | RISK-005 | Sarah Chen, CISO | accepted | 2 | 6 | 2024-10-18 | — |
| RA-004 | RISK-007 | Sarah Chen, CISO | accepted | 6 | 6 | 2024-10-22 | 2025-10-01 |

Each row is immutable and chained into the HMAC audit log — an auditor can verify who accepted which residual risk, when, and against which threshold, without relying on free-text notes.
